intro: The imperfect in the past has an ongoing activity or context; the perfect focuses a complete result or fact.

texto: The imperfect in the past has an ongoing activity or context; the perfect focuses a complete result or fact.
It may mean that I was reading; it is indicated that I finished it.

frases.en: When I called, Anna was reading.

frases.es: Para la tarde, Anna había leído la carta.
frases.en: By the afternoon, Anna had read the letter.

bloques.pregunta: What way does it stand out that the letter is over?

opciones.explicacion: The про- prefix here marks the complete result.
